en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a rural village landscape. The image shows patchworked fields bordered by hedges and fences, scattered farm buildings and detached houses, and a small cluster of larger buildings near the center that looks like a village core. Beyond the cultivated land there is a dense forest stretching to the horizon under a cloudy sky. No captions or printed text are visible on the image.
